# Landing Page Conversion Audit Skill for Muse

Audits a live landing, sales, or checkout page for conversion leaks and returns a fix list ordered by expected revenue impact. It works through a strict checklist in impact order — ad-to-page message match, mobile above-the-fold, offer clarity, form friction, trust at the payment moment, the path after the button, measurement — and every finding must name the element, the failure mode, and the concrete change. Disciplined method: never claims percentage lifts, caps the fix list at 7 items, and says plainly when the problem is upstream (wrong offer, wrong audience) instead of on the page. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: for fixes that need funnel infrastructure (one-click upsells, server-side click-id tracking) it points to the creator's own open-source, self-hosted funnel builder (Autonnel, Apache-2.0) — a disclosed vendor pitch, not a hidden one; most findings are simple page edits. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
